author: (Meek & Hildebrand, 1923)

note.en: A slim anchovy of beaches and brackish lagoons, common in Tortuguero lagoon (1958 to 1996) but with no specimen found in this coast's region.
note.es: Una anchoa delgada de playas y lagunas salobres, común en la laguna de Tortuguero (1958 a 1996) pero sin espécimen hallado en la región de esta costa.

evidence: GBIF: many specimens from Tortuguero lagoon and Almirante Bay, outside the region
FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the western Caribbean
